Did you know Alex was up to something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you even know any of the guys who hang out in the Auto-Shop?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... No, I haven't actually met them, per se.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I'm sure they'll help! Not everyone is as cynical as you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! I'm just being realistic! I don't want you to be disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, why don't you let me make my own decisions instead of trying to look out for me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, I've got a float to work on. If you're not going to help, you might as well get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, listen, maybe I could help you out after all... If you need some help painting or something...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think you've made your position on it completely clear!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...
Howard turns and sadly leaves.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe I was a little harsh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But he was still being a jerk! And I don't think I even want the help of a guy who thinks school spirit is lame!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can design this float all by myself... And when it wins, he'll be the one regretting it!
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All right... I think I've got it...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: A giant mechanical lizard on top... Surrounded by white and green garlands... And students dressed as lizards dancing around!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now, I just need to draw an outline...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yawn.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Feeling... Sleepy... Must... Focus...
Focus on the outline! Don't fall asleep!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Too... Tired... To... Work...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm never going to make it without some caffeine... What's an extra cup of coffee, right? Or three? Or four?
Linda passes out half an hour later after scribbling all over the paper in a caffeine-induced fit.
The next morning...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What was I thinking? This drawing is terrible!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The lizard looks like a cow... And why is he wearing a fireman's hat? And what's he doing in Morocco?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm late for school! I guess it'll just have to do...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There's got to be someone else on this campus who cares about school spirit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Like who?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Well...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I can't think of anyone... But I can think of plenty of people who'd help for a shot at $10,000...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not to mention the chance to stick it to Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, you got me there. Heck, even I'd kind of like to show them up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember last year, when the Centerscore Auto-Shop kids let four wild goats loose in their locker room? That was hilarious!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly! The Auto-Shop kids hate Wilson High... And I'm sure they'd know a lot about how to build a float!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'll get them to help!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're seriously going to try to build it all by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's just... Do you have any idea how to actually do it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, how to put it together? Where to get the parts? How to make sure it doesn't fall apart and kill twenty people?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I don't really know anything like that...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But who cares? I'll ask the Auto-Shop kids to help me out! I'm sure they'll know!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry, Linda... But I thought you needed help with some schoolwork or something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if I thought we could win, I really just don't have the time to help you out with this.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was hoping this would be a really good chance to get to know each other better...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I guess Howard isn't interested!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, um, do you want to watch some TV or something?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh? What are you talking about? I've got to work on the float!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're still going to do it? Even without my help?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course! I'm not giving up just because 'it isn't your thing'!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not what I meant... I was just wondering how you planned to pull it off!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm going to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? How?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought the rest of your Spirit Council was just spoiled rich girls who don't even care!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, are they even helping you with this project?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not trying to rag on your friends or anything... But Centerscore just isn't a 'school spirit' kind of place!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe you're right... But I'm sure Centerscore has plenty of spirit hidden away! It just has to be inspired!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Talk about being a 'glass half full' kind of person!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I like to think of it as a glass in need of more water!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's one way to look at it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's not really my perspective.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This year, I'm not going to let the other girls on the Council get me down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Even if I'm the only one at Centerscore with any real spirit, I'm going to win this thing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... You really are determined, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's so cool... I would've probably given up if I were you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So you'll help me out?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not what I said.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Talking to yourself again?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! I'm so glad to see you! I wasn't sure you were free tonight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, technically, I had piano practice... But why would I want to bang on some boring old keys when I could be helping out a friend?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww... That's sweet!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's so strange not knowing where I stand with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The two of us kissed the last Fourth of July... But since then, we've been acting just like friends!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe he doesn't like me... Or maybe he's just too shy to act on his feelings...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then again, I don't really know how I feel about him either!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, what's this project you need my help with? Science fair? English paper?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually... I was hoping you could help me build the school float for the town parade!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, no, nothing's wrong. It's just... That's not really my scene, you know? That's not, um, what I do.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... I mean... School spirit... It's kind of lame, you know?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't mean lame, like, you shouldn't do it or anything... It's just, I dunno, kind of dorky.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You think it's lame? Mr. 'The Fourth Of July Is So Important' thinks it's lame?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, the Fourth of July is a national holiday! It's not some dumb school spirit thing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just really wedging my foot in my mouth, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, even if you don't like school spirit... There's a $10,000 prize this time! You must want to win that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is a lot of cash... But come on. We're not going to win. Wilson beats us every time!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They've beaten us before... But this time, I bet we can do it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah? Why? What's different?
Later that evening...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see... Maybe we could have a giant lizard head where people jump out of the eyes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: On second thought, that's kind of creepy...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I don't care! I'll make this float without them... And I'll show them how the Spirit Council should be run!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, you did not just say what I think you said.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did not just say that you think a dinosaur is prettier than my face... `Did you?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You did not just say that you think a dinosaur is prettier than my face... [color=#3b78e2][i]Did you?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! No, honest! That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because that sure is what it sounded like...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor? Can you... Uh... Put down the scissors...
Taylor glares at Linda for one long, tense minute...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're lucky Amanda likes you, Linda. That'll keep you safe... Today.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Next time... Well, let's just say I hope you like the nickname 'One-Eye'!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: GULP!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... What about the float...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, so should I have my dad pick up a dinosaur or not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, shut up already!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're gone...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No offense, Amanda, but that idea just isn't very realistic.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't know what that word means!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know. I know.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Could we quit yapping and start making this stupid outline?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We'll need some graph paper...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And some pencils...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ooh, and a compass...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And these rulers...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And of course, some glue...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, and we can't forget the yarn...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, and there's the tape measure...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And last but not least, a calculator!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you girls ready to...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...Girls?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They... They left...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, Linda, you've convinced us. Let's build a float!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm so glad you're helping me out with this... I know it might be a lot of work...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I'm sure it'll all be worth it in the end!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Let's just get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Well, the first step would to be come up with a design. What do you guys think really represents Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh ooh, I know this, I know this! The Centerscore High mascot is a lizard... So we should totally have a lizard on our float!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We need to get one of those giant lizards... The kind that have huge teeth and spikes, and they run around and chase people and roar all day!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you thinking of a dinosaur?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! Let's get one of those!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't mean to be the bearer of bad news... But those aren't really around anymore.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't worry, my dad can get one. He's totally rich.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, forget your stupid dinosaur! I clearly represent Centerscore better than anyone... And so the float should just be a giant version of my face!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It should have a dinosaur!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It should have my face!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Dinosaur!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Linda, you decide! What's better, a dinosaur or my face?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... Kind of an odd question...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ANSWER IT!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Can you imagine what kind of a prom we could throw with $10,000?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that you mention it... We could get Gashley Simpson to perform!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We could hire butlers to escort people around and super-butlers to escort the butlers!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I could spend $9,000 of it on a dress...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's not really what I had in mind...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Centerscore High desperately needs a new soccer field! I'm on the girls soccer team, and most of the time, we have to practice in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If we had our own soccer field, I'm sure we could make it to the State Semifinals!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, and why would I possibly care about what our soccer team does?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You don't like soccer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Running around a stupid field, getting all sweaty while I'm yelled at by some middle-aged jerk on a power trip?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sounds like my last date!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sigh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess we could also probably donate the money to the cheerleading squad.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! You're totally right! I bet we could buy new uniforms!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We totally need them! My top has, like, a smudge on it! My mom said to put it in the washer, but it was full of dishes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The cheerleading squad has way too much money already... But if it'll get them to help me out...
Our story begins at Centerscore High... Where the Spirit Council is gathered for an important meeting!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now girls, as you know, the annual `Centerscore Town Parade` is this weekend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now girls, as you know, the annual [color=#3b78e2][i]Centerscore Town Parade[/i][/color] is this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And that means it's time to make Centerscore High's entry for the float contest!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This is stupid. Who cares about some dumb float?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And it's not like we have a chance. Wilson High wins every year!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So? Just because we've lost before doesn't mean we can't win this year!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, it's nice that you wanted to come along to our meeting, Linda, but that doesn't really give you a right to take part in it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't forget... I run this club!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Technically, `I` run this club... And I appreciate Linda's enthusiasm.
nodes.text_bbcode: Technically, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] run this club... And I appreciate Linda's enthusiasm.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: But you should all know that this year, there's a lot more on the line than just school pride.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: As you might recall, due to a clerical error, the town of Centerscore accidentally received twenty million dollars in volcano relief.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Weren't we supposed to give that money back?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Yeah, well, things happen. The point is, the town has decided to give the high school with the best float a `$10,000 prize!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, things happen. The point is, the town has decided to give the high school with the best float a [color=#3b78e2][i]$10,000 prize![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's like, half a million dollars!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: For the sixth time, Amanda, I'm going to have to recommend remedial math classes.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Ahem. The point is, the school could really use that money, and I'm sure the Spirit Council would have some say in where it goes.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I know we don't have a ton of time on this project... But I trust you girls to make the best darn float you can!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We won't let you down!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a self-defense class to attend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, I thought she'd never leave!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Seriously! Now let's talk about the important stuff...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My sixteenth birthday party!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Shouldn't we work on the float? We only have a couple of days to put it together!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, Linda, no one cares about some dumb float in a stupid parade.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... Think of all the good things the school could do with $10,000!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We could...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know, I know, it's not the best drawing...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hmm... I don't know about this... You really think a giant kidney bean would be a good icon for the float?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What? No! It's a giant lizard!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... I guess I see it... sort of...
Kenji turns the paper sideways and squints...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess I could just improvise.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Man, you really are nuts, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What... What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I mean, you actually believe in this junk.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Come on. Everyone's stuck in their little cliques, safe in their comfort zone. School spirit's a joke.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I don't think it's a joke at all!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think if more people really believed in working together, then we `could` beat Wilson, fair and square!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think if more people really believed in working together, then we [color=#3b78e2][i]could[/i][/color] beat Wilson, fair and square!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'll just be going now.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You really think Centerscore could come together like that?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I really do.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Then prove it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That right there is a `'79 Crabillac`. I want you to change the spark plugs.
nodes.text_bbcode: That right there is a [color=#e23b3b][i]'79 Crabillac[/i][/color]. I want you to change the spark plugs.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What? But... But I've never done that before!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah? So why not try something new? Or would you prefer to stay in your comfort zone?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's just see what we're working with...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's see... This squiggly part looks like that stretchy part... And I bet I could squeeze that hose in there...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aha! That fits perfectly! Done!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What? No way!
Kenji peers into the engine.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did I do it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, it's not perfect... But it's a lot better than I expected.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All right. You win. I'll help you with your float. What did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmm... Let's see... That nozzle looks like it goes on that vent... And I guess I could probably take out that valve...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There! Done!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Let me see.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What... What have you done?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is it not right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This is an abomination... I didn't know you could even do this to a poor engine...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nobody touch the Crabillac! It might explode!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess you won't help me then...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well... A deal's a deal. What did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was thinking something like this.
Linda reaches into her backpack and hands Kenji her outline.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Every year, Wilson beats us, but it's just because we don't try!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If more people believed in Centerscore, instead of just trying to fit in with their little cliques...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sure we could win!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You really mean that? You're not just after the $10,000 prize?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...You know about that?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Word travels fast.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I'm sure the school could do great things with that money... But that's not what matters.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And what does matter?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just making a darn good float, I guess!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Right, right. I heard about that through the grapevine. $10,000 prize, huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yep! Just think of all the neat things we could buy for Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Just because I hang out in shop doesn't mean I'm stupid, you know.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Do you really think anyone in the school is going to want to spend that money on Auto-Shop? We're already the most underfunded class!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The Wilson High Auto-Shop gets brand-new tools... Meanwhile, we're lucky if we get an old headlight, a screwdriver, and some twine!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I'll put in a good word! I'm sure the other students will listen!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's going on over here?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Nothing. Some girl from the Spirit Council was bugging us for our help... Not like we'd give it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I prefer to speak for myself.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmph!
Megan glares at Linda and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sorry about her. She can be... Intense.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey... this guy is really cute! How have I never met him before?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What kind of a project do you want our help on?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I'm in charge of making the float for the town parade. I had a really good idea, but I need, well, I need a giant mechanical lizard.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is that even remotely possible?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nothing's impossible.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean I want to do it. Why would I waste my time making some float?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but do I look like the School Spirit type?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Maybe there's someone else here who can...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're barking up the wrong tailpipe, little girl. Around here, we're into cannons, engines, and things that go boom.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Unless you want your float to be an all-terrain death machine, you're gonna want to look somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't think I want that at all!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What... Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Like... Like `Mecha Grodzrilla?` My favorite movie of all time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like... Like [color=#3b78e2][i]Mecha Grodzrilla?[/i][/color] My favorite movie of all time?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We could give him flame-throwers in his mouth... Laser beam eyes... Fireworks that shoot out of his back...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ooooh! We could cover his claws in dripping fake blood!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... That's not what I had in mind.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You either do Grodzrilla right or you don't do him at all!!!
